ZubCut Quick Network Diagnostic — paste into Command Prompt
============================================================

1) Open Windows PowerShell as Administrator (not cmd).
   OR open Admin Command Prompt and paste the one line below.

2) Copy EVERYTHING between the markers (one line) and press Enter.

3) Screenshot the SUMMARY in Notepad.

----- COPY FROM HERE -----
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand 
----- COPY TO HERE -----

Notes:
- French Windows: gateway label "Passerelle par défaut" is supported.
- Prefer PowerShell Admin if the EncodedCommand line is awkward to paste.
